import numpy as np

def sigmoid(x):
    return 1 / (1 + np.exp(-x))

# OR gate training data
X = np.array([[0,0], [0,1], [1,0], [1,1]])
y = np.array([[0], [1], [1], [1]])

np.random.seed(42)
weights = np.random.randn(2, 1)
bias = np.zeros((1, 1))

# Train for 10000 epochs
for _ in range(10000):
    out = sigmoid(np.dot(X, weights) + bias)
    err = y - out
    adj = err * out * (1 - out)
    weights += 0.5 * np.dot(X.T, adj)
    bias += 0.5 * np.sum(adj)

# Print predictions
for i in range(4):
    pred = sigmoid(np.dot(X[i], weights) + bias)
    print(f'{X[i]} -> {pred.item():.3f}')
